explication: Serial Studio is a live hardware telemetry dashboard. A user configures a project, connects one or more serial, network, Bluetooth, industrial, or other supported sources, then receives parsed and transformed frames as dashboard widgets. The same data can drive commands, recording, replay, exports, APIs, and optional integrations. The graph emphasizes the documented runtime architecture; several Pro subsystems are represented by their exact enclosing source areas because their implementations were not sampled.
